name: the bundled closed example
sentence: This is a closed network: a fixed number of customers circulates and nothing arrives from outside. Capacity planning covers open networks.

name: the closed example with no population
sentence: The network has no source and no sink, but no number of customers is set. Set the population to make it a closed network. Capacity planning covers open networks, which have a source and a sink.
